route: Work permit (Office of the Prime Minister)

permit.applies: The applicant returns the application form (in duplicate) to the Office of the Prime Minister's Work Permit Department with a letter from the employer; Cabinet approves it, and the permit fee is paid on acceptance.
permit.first: A letter from the employer and proof that the position has been advertised.

fees.what: Work permit, over 90 days up to 12 months (non-CARICOM)
Work permit, CARICOM nationals, per annum

sources.title: St Vincent and the Grenadines Consulate, Work Permit (requirements and fees as of 1 March 2016)
sources.said: Complete Work Permit Application Form (in duplicate) along with the following and Return Application Form to the Office of the Prime Minister (Work Permit Department): … Letter from employer … Proof that the position applied for has been advertised … The documents will be sent to Cabinet for approval (see list of fees below upon acceptance) … A work permit ONLY is issued on a one-time basis for not more than six (6) months. Applicants requesting more than six (6) months for a work permit are required to additionally submit an application for a residence permit. Fees – (as of March 01, 2016) - subject to change Work Permits Application Fee EC$200.00 (non-refundable) CARICOM Nationals EC$960.00 per annum Others: For a period up to 30 days EC$700.00 For a period up to 60 days EC$1400.00 For a period up to 90 days EC$2100.00 For a period over 90 days up to 12 months EC$2400.00

blockers.sought: Whether the 2016 fees (marked 'subject to change') still stand
